structure.note: Class A shares carry one vote and Class B shares 20 votes; Class B is convertible at any time into Class A on a share-for-share basis. All Class B shares are beneficially owned by David Baszucki, giving him 58.8% of total voting power at February 13, 2026.

notes: Fiscal year ended December 31, 2025. Financial figures are from the FY2025 Form 10-K (accession 0001315098-26-000024), checked against SEC XBRL; ownership is from the 2026 proxy (DEF 14A, accession 0001104659-26-044362), as of February 13, 2026. Roblox reincorporated from Delaware to Nevada on May 30, 2025. LEADER: David Baszucki, co-founder, President and CEO. The proxy states 100% of Class B and 58.8% of total voting power (Class A marked * for less than 1%), not a percentage of all shares, so pctEconomic is null and the computed figure is in leader.derived. His Class B shares are held through trusts: The Freedom Revocable Trust (he is trustee), the 2020 Jan Baszucki Gift Trust (he exercises control) and the 2020 David Baszucki Gift Trust (his spouse exercises control). Class B fell from 48,293,658 to 47,070,464 shares over the year. Director Gregory Baszucki (12,078,807 Class A, 1.8%) is listed separately in the proxy and is not added. HOLDERS: largestHolders is null, not empty. The proxy's 5% holders are FMR LLC (49,459,521 Class A, 7.5% of Class A, 3.1% of votes; 13G/A as of June 30, 2025) and BlackRock (35,494,495 Class A, 5.4% of Class A, 2.2% of votes; 13G as of September 30, 2025); those are percentages of Class A only, and only the leader's figure may be derived. CASH: no dividends have ever been paid and the cash-flow statement has no share repurchases. GEOGRAPHY: United States alone was 57% of 2025 revenue (10-K footnote).

payouts.label: Developer exchange fees paid to creators

ecosystem.notes: Bookings is a non-GAAP measure (sales of Robux and subscriptions, before deferral). Roblox records revenue gross, as principal, so Revenue includes the money later paid to developers; developer exchange fees are an expense line, recognised 'as earned Robux are accumulated by creators that are qualified and registered in the Developer Exchange Program'. Revenue / Bookings therefore overstates what Roblox keeps. Developer exchange fees are the expense recognised in 2025, not necessarily cash paid in 2025.
ecosystem.ratioNote: Roblox records revenue gross, so revenue already includes amounts later paid to developers; the share would understate what creators receive.

paidout.notes: Fiscal year ended December 31, 2025 (FY2025 Form 10-K, accession 0001315098-26-000024). Revenue is recognized over the paying user's estimated lifetime, so cash collected runs ahead of revenue: deferred revenue rose 1,935,318 and deferred cost of revenue 331,395 inside operating cash flow, which lowers paidOut for the year by much more than in 2024. Interest income (201,610) is inside operating cash flow but not revenue. Taxes paid now come from the income-tax note's by-jurisdiction table (ASU 2023-09). Not an admitted marketplace for salesEnabled.
